events.title: Lightning near Prospect Plains
events.description: 1 death. Middlesex County. A man was fatally struck by lightning in a solar field on Hoffman Station Road in Monroe Township. The individual was transported to a nearby hospital where he was pronounced deceased.

events.title: Lightning near Jackson
events.description: 1 death. Ocean County. There was 1 fatality and 14 injuries reported at an archery range in Jackson Township due to a lightning strike.

events.title: Flash Flood near Plainfield
events.description: 2 deaths. Union County. Two fatalities in car that became submerged in flood waters on Stelle Avenue, then dragged into Cedar Brook.

events.title: Lightning near Hardystonville
events.description: 1 death. Sussex County. Local news reports that a 28 year old man was injured from a lightning strike while golfing. He later died from his injuries. Time estimated from radar and lightning data.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Plainfield
events.description: 2 deaths. Union County. Large tree fallen on car on Myrtle Avenue near Mariners Place with 2 occupants deceased.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Watsessing
events.description: 1 death. Essex County. A tree fell on a 30 year old male near North Munn Avenue in East Orange NJ. The man died an hour later at the hospital.

events.title: Lightning near Seaside Hgts
events.description: 1 death. Ocean County. A man was struck and killed by lightning as he was returning to the beach to warn others about the impending thunderstorm.

events.title: Flash Flood near Irvington
events.description: 2 deaths. Essex County. A 66 year old man and his 46 year old daughter died as a result of flooding after going into the basement of their home on Lincoln Place in Irvington to secure it as the Elizabeth River began to overflow.

events.title: Flash Flood near Brills Jct
events.description: 1 death. Essex County. A car carrying two Seton Hall University students was overcome by flood waters on Main Avenue near Benson Avenue in Passaic. The body of one of the students, a 21 year old man, was later found in Newark after being swept down the Passaic River.

events.title: Flash Flood near Kearny
events.description: 1 death. Hudson County. A car carrying two Seton Hall University students was overcome by flood waters on Main Avenue near Benson Avenue in Passaic. The body of one of the students, an 18 year old woman, was later found in Kearny after being swept down the Passaic River.

events.title: Flash Flood near (cdw)esx Co Arpt Cal
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Essex County. An unidentified person died by electrocution as a result of flooding in Essex County.

events.title: Flash Flood near Mahwah
events.description: 1 death. Bergen County. One person died at a hospital in Bergen County after pushing their car through flood waters and suffering a medical event.

events.title: Flash Flood near Maplewood
events.description: 1 death. Essex County. A 55 year old man was found dead on Ridgewood Road in the vicinity of Berkeley Road in Maplewood due to flooding. He is believed to have been swept away by flood waters while attempting to remove debris from drains in the area.

events.title: Flash Flood near Elizabeth
events.description: 4 deaths. Union County. Four people died due to flooding at the Oakwood Plaza apartment complex on Irvington Avenue in Elizabeth. All four people were found in one apartment and included a 74 year old woman, her 71 year old husband, their 38 year old son, and a 33 year old neighbor.

events.title: Flash Flood near Clifton
events.description: 1 death. Passaic County. The Passaic River at Dundee Dam in Clifton rose above its minor flood stage of 4.5 feet at 10:15pm EDT and crested at a height of 4.98 feet at 12:45am EDT September 2nd. The river then fell back below flood stage at 3:45am EDT on September 2nd. Flooding from the Passaic River resulted in three fatalities. A 70 year old man died when his car became stranded in 6 feet of water at the intersection of Passaic Avenue and Lackawana Place in Passaic.

events.title: Flash Flood near Kenilworth
events.description: 1 death. Union County. An 83 year old man was found on Chestnut Street in Union Township near Overlook Hospital. He is believed to have drowned after his car got stuck and he walked out into 3-4 feet of water.

events.title: Flash Flood near Branchburg Park
events.description: 2 deaths. Somerset County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in the southern half of Somerset County with numerous road closures. There were two flood related fatalities in southern Somerset County, both in Hillsborough Township. There were approximately 1200 water rescues in the entire county. Many buildings and homes were either damaged or destroyed by the flood waters. Most waterways in the county overflowed their banks, including the Raritan River, the Millstone River, Green Brook, Stony Brook and Middle Brook.

events.title: Flash Flood near Branchburg Park
events.description: 3 deaths. Somerset County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in the northern half of Somerset County with numerous roads closures. There were three flood related fatalities in northern Somerset County, all in Bridgewater Township. There were approximately 1200 water rescues in the entire county. Many buildings and homes were either damaged or destroyed by the flood waters. Most waterways in the county overflowed their banks, including the Raritan River, the Millstone River, Green Brook, Stony Brook and Middle Brook.

events.title: Flash Flood near Riegel Ridge
events.description: 6 deaths. Hunterdon County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in Hunterdon County with numerous road closures. There were over 300 water rescues in the county. A total of six flood related fatalities were reported, one in Milford, one in East Amwell Township, and four in Raritan Township. Many buildings and homes were damaged by the flood waters. Most waterways in the county overflowed their banks, including the South Branch of the Raritan River, the Neshanic River and Spruce Run.

events.title: Flash Flood near Middlesex
events.description: 3 deaths (2 direct, 1 indirect). Middlesex County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in Middlesex County with numerous road closures and over 500 water rescues. A total of three flood related fatalities were reported in the county, one in South Plainfield, one in Piscataway Township, and one in Woodbridge Township. There was significant damage to structures and vehicles, mainly in the northern part of the county. Many waterways overflowed their banks, including the Lawrence Brook.

events.title: Flash Flood near Titusville
events.description: 2 deaths. Mercer County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in Mercer County with numerous road closures and nearly 100 water rescues. There were two flood related fatalities in the county, both in Hopewell Township. Many waterways overflowed their banks including the Assunpink Creek, Stony Brook and the Delaware River (with a highly unusual quick response to the runoff).

events.title: Lightning near Seaside Park
events.description: 1 death. Ocean County. Seven individuals were struck by lightning in South Seaside Park, with one fatality.

events.title: Lightning near Timbuctoo
events.description: 1 death. Burlington County. A man in his 70s was struck and killed by lightning at Burlington Country Club. This was the first documented case of a fatal lightning strike in the United States in 2021. Time estimated from radar and dispatch calls.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Convent Station
events.description: 1 death. Morris County. One person died and One other person critically injured when a tree fell onto a moving car traveling on Ford Road. Person died on June 22, 2018.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Passaic
events.description: 1 death. Passaic County. A large tree limb fell onto Paulison Avenue, killing one person and injuring six. Nearby Observations (KCDW and KTEB) and radar support winds of between 40 and 50 mph.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Fanwood
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Union County. Trees and power lines were down at the intersection of Midway and Hunter Avenues just northwest of Fanwood. One of the wires fell on a vehicle. The occupant of the vehicle got out of the vehicle and was electrocuted, resulting in a fatality.

events.title: Flash Flood near Clifton
events.description: 1 death. Passaic County. Two men from the Occupational Safety and Health Administration were in the Weasel Brook inspecting the President Street Bridge in the town of Passaic when it started raining profusely. The heavy rains caused the water level to rise from several inches to approximately eleven feet in minutes sweeping both men away. One man was rescued, but the other was not and was found deceased in the Passaic River the following day.
